Set Protocol is a protocol built on the Ethereum public blockchain. Set Protocol operates through smart contracts rather than intermediaries. Set Protocol issues tokenized baskets of ERC-20 tokens, known as Sets. Set Protocol is focused on asset management and index-style portfolios.

Zerion is a DeFi portfolio tracking and wallet interface. Zerion aggregates a user's positions across multiple decentralized applications. Zerion is non-custodial, so it does not hold users' assets.

Zapper is a DeFi dashboard and portfolio tracking interface. Zapper lets users interact with several decentralized protocols from one interface. Zapper is non-custodial, so it does not take custody of users' assets.
